title: InternalProcessObjectiveDetail
description: Per-call schema for internal-processes Round 3 (per-objective elaboration). The `id` (I{theme_idx}.{obj_idx}) and `title` are NOT requested — both are determined by upstream context (theme position, title-list position). `linked_opportunity_indices` was added in Phase 1b of `redesign-analysis-visuals` so the AI annotates each objective with the opportunities that would advance it.

linked_opportunity_indices.description: 0-based indices into the `opportunities` array shown in the prompt. List opportunities whose execution would directly advance THIS objective. Empty list when no opportunity in the list applies.
